WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing') AS powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'Missing')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(telescope_count) AS REAL) AS total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    telescope_count,
    CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share,
    1.0 / CAST(num_statuses AS REAL) AS avg_share
  FROM status_counts, totals
),
above_avg_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    telescope_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM status_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes_above_avg,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_above_avg,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_above_avg
FROM above_avg_statuses
